population.condition: type 2 diabetes mellitus and coronary artery disease requiring PCI with drug-eluting stent implantation
key_inclusion_criteria: known or newly diagnosed type 2 diabetes
eligible for PCI with implantation of a drug-eluting stent
indication for PCI including stable angina, unstable angina or non-ST elevation myocardial infarction (NSTEMI)
evidence: The study aimed to include female and male subjects aged 18 to 80 years with known or newly diagnosed T2D, HbA1c between 47–110 mmol/mol, who were eligible for PCI with implantation of a DES. :chatgpt-content-reference{index=
The mean age was 66.6 years and 58% of subjects were men, corresponding to 42% women. :chatgpt-content-reference{index=

arms.name: Exenatide
evidence: Participants were randomized to Bydureon 2 mg once weekly by subcutaneous injection plus standard treatment. :chatgpt-content-reference{index=
The randomized population included 20 participants in the exenatide group; the follow-up table reports 16 participants for the exenatide group. :chatgpt-content-reference{index=

arms.name: Control
evidence: Participants were randomized to standard treatment alone; standard treatment was defined as metformin and NPH insulin. :chatgpt-content-reference{index=
